llms.body:
# Zeta Global

> Zeta Global is an AI-powered marketing platform that helps enterprises acquire, grow, and retain customers through data-driven, individualized experiences. Zeta unifies identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation in a single cloud so marketers can turn signals into personalized customer journeys.

## Platform

- [Zeta Marketing Platform](https://www.zetaglobal.com/): Overview of Zeta's AI-powered marketing and advertising platform.
- [Products](https://www.zetaglobal.com/products/): Programmatic display, email, mobile messaging, and connected TV.
- [Solutions](https://www.zetaglobal.com/solutions/omnichannel-marketing/): Solutions for acquisition, customer growth, and retention.
- [Industries](https://www.zetaglobal.com/industries/): How Zeta serves retail, financial services, travel, media, and more.

## Company

- [About Zeta](https://www.zetaglobal.com/about/): Company mission, leadership, and story.
- [Press & News](https://www.zetaglobal.com/press-news/): Announcements and news coverage.
- [Partners](https://www.zetaglobal.com/partners/): Zeta's partner ecosystem.

## Resources

- [Resource Center](https://www.zetaglobal.com/resource-center/): Articles, guides, reports, and customer stories.
- [Customer Stories](https://www.zetaglobal.com/customer-stories/): Customer success stories and results.

## Contact

- [Request a Demo](https://www.zetaglobal.com/request-a-demo/): Get in touch with the Zeta team.

Zeta Global Teams Up with Fireworks to Unveil New Specialized Athena Inference Models Using NVIDIA NemotronRead News

A NEW WAY TO WORK

Take your business
anywhere with
AthenaOS.

Drive growth with enterprise intelligence that builds around your ambition. Tell Athena what you want to achieve, and let the system put it into action.

Zeta Introduces AthenaOS, the Enterprise Intelligence Operating System that Turns Intelligence into Growth

Helping Top Brands Achieve the Impossible™

Smarter Decisions. Better Results.

Zeta's unified, intelligent system transforms deeper customer understanding into confident action, faster execution, and measurable business outcomes.

Know Your Customers

with Precision

Understanding your customers is one thing. Anticipating their behavior is another.  

Powered by the Zeta Data Cloud (including one of the industry’s most advanced identity graphs), Zeta delivers intelligence built around individuals—not segments—for precision at scale.

This intelligence continuously learns and improves, giving the brands we serve a smarter advantage in an increasingly AI-driven world.

Grow Across the Full Customer Lifecycle

Enterprises have long operated in silos. Customers don’t. Zeta's single platform spans the full customer lifecycle—from acquisition to loyalty—so every interaction is connected, personalized, and optimized.

  • Turn fragmented data into a clear, actionable view of each individual and their journey.CDP
  • Make every customer interaction more relevant, consistent, and memorable.Advertising
  • Reach people most likely to convert using better data and efficient, scalable targeting.Acquisition
  • Engage every customer in whichever channel they interact with the most.Messaging
  • Strengthen customer relationships through meaningful rewards and experiences.Loyalty
  • Optimize cross-channel campaigns using real-time signals to increase efficiency and ROI.Analytics
Intelligence Hub

Prove the Results

with Certainty

The modern market demands more than the promise of growth. It must be measurable and profitable.

 From acquisition to retention, Zeta ties every dollar spent to real outcomes, giving decision-makers the confidence to invest where they know they'll win.

Every action is optimized. Every result is accountable. Because the future of business isn't just intelligent—it's provable.
